name: committee
description:
Runs the three critics in parallel on the current draft: prosecute checks each cited claim against its quotes, reproduce re-derives the plan's answers from the documents without seeing the draft, and audit_gaps lists what a specialist would expect and cannot find. Each critic is context-free: it sees only its own typed request. It returns the cycle number and the critics' findings with severities (C1, C2, …); resolve each HIGH or MEDIUM one with ledger op resolve, by fixing it (redraft, more evidence) or disclosing it. finish needs a committee on the current draft while the budget can still fund a fix. Do not use it before every plan issue has a drafted section, and do not call it again without changing the draft.
